questions.question: In the following questions, four words are given, out of which only one word is correctly spelt. Find the correctly spelt word.
questions.questionHtml: In the following questions, four words are given, out of which only one word is correctly spelt. Find the correctly spelt word.
questions.solution:
'Extravagant' is the correctly spelt word.

The correct spellings of the other words are: proceeding, humiliate and intrigued.

Proceeding: a series of activities

Extravagant: spending too much money

Humiliate: To insult someone

Intrigued: To interest someone a lot

Hence, option(b) is the right answer.

questions.questionHtml:
Select the option with the correct spellings to replace the underlined words in the given sentence.

She chanelised her energy into creative persuits.
questions.solution:
Channelised (Correct Spelling): The correct spelling of the word that means to direct or guide something, in this case, energy, into a particular course or activity is "channelised." In this context, it suggests directing energy in a focused way.

Pursuits (Correct Spelling): The correct spelling of the word that refers to activities or tasks that one engages in, especially as a hobby or profession, is "pursuits." In the sentence, it implies that the person is directing her energy into creative activities.

Hence, (d) is the correct answer.
